svg.aria-label: Pipeline of the genetic DNA language model
svg.text: How the DNA language model is built
genetic / model — from the hg19 reference genome to a scored variant. Every command runs from model/ with uv run.

text.tspan: plain .fa so pyfaidx can read any region

svg.text: Turn DNA text into integer ids, one

text.tspan: a→A … then any other letter → N
Split("."): every base is its own piece
look each piece up in VOCAB
drop windows with more than 1% N
split by chromosome: train chr22, val chr21

svg.text: Teach a small transformer to predict the

text.tspan: 4,000 steps · batch 16 · lr 1e-3 cosine · Apple MPS
eval loss in bits every 500 steps

svg.text: Is the model better than simple

text.tspan: validation windows with no N, as 0–3
uniform guess = 2.0 bits, lower is better
1,024 bp of hg19 around the variant
log P(alt window) − log P(ref window)

svg.text: Share the model with a model card.

text.tspan: README.md from the config + eval results
model, tokenizer, card → Hugging Face Hub
load_config(), resolve(): paths relative to model/
